method: Same healthy seed1 native setup and same actual WASD segment-following controller on both existing authored paths. correction: Original endpoint-only pursuit tolerated an approximately 6–8m parallel offset at the east road turn; the safe car struck verge props and lost HP during recovery. Short12m segment lookahead, .02rad steering deadband, normal S braking above6m/s on sharp turns and the same6m waypoint threshold apply to both prescribed routes. Acceptance targets/billing/check evaluation unchanged.
